notes.title: Update Notes for 22nd January 2022
notes.content:
Hello, citizens!

I've updated the Mac build to fix an error that got introduced with a recent OS update. It was loading some libraries in the wrong order, causing an error on startup. Should be fixed now. Let me know if you encounter any problems!

Thanks,
David

notes.title: Update Notes for 3rd December, 2021
notes.content: I fixed an odd issue with Windows scaling - if your monitor was set to anything other than 100% display scaling, you could experience blurry graphics or too-large window sizes. This has now been fixed.

notes.title: Update Notes for November 18th, 2021
notes.content:
Hello Citizens!

I've just updated the build to use the latest FNALibs, which should make it as ready as possible for the upcoming Steam Deck. I fixed a bug where the UI didn't show the correct resolution on the Deck (it still showed 1920x1080, even though the Deck only supports 1280x800). There are also some fixes for when the game is running standalone outside of Steam, although that shouldn't really affect anyone.

Thanks,
TheDaddis
